rights.edits: Trimmed and framed with original, AI-assisted educational commentary. Archive footage is labeled throughout.

frameReview.method: Local review of 42 source samples and five rendered frames. Normal-speed 30 fps source is sampled to 25 fps.
frameReview.sourceTimeRange: First 20.000 seconds of the archive clip. Encoded timestamps start at 0.066667 seconds.
frameReview.visuals: A volcanic landscape, plume and lava fountain. The reviewed frames show no people, logos or visible third-party artwork.
frameReview.changes: Original narrative text and attribution occupy separate panels. The portrait source stays whole, and all output frames are silent.

reviewScope: The exact educational edit and its attributed use in Clips. Pexels terms exclude standalone stock distribution and partisan uses.
